description:
Unit Converter turns any measurement into any other as fast as you can type. Eight categories — length, weight, temperature, volume, speed, area, time and data — cover everything from homework to cooking to travel.

A big, clear display and a purpose-built keypad mean there's no fiddling with tiny text boxes. Results update live with every key press, and the list underneath shows your value in every other unit at once. Tap any row to make it your target, or hit swap to flip the conversion around.

Unit Converter remembers the units you used last in every category, works completely offline, and looks great in both light and dark mode.
whatsNew: Redesigned from the ground up: live "all units" list, new Data and Time categories, and smarter number formatting.
